comment: Edit decisions for episode 1. Times in seconds. segments are [sourceStart, sourceEnd, rate] in take.mp4 (cue log time = video time, sync offset measured with blackdetect). Highlights are frame boxes in 1920x1080 pixels, times relative to the beat. lift raises a caption above the composer while it is in use.

captions.text: Claude Code in SpecWithCode: plan, build, review.
It adds `AGENTS.md` and eleven SpecWeave skills.
Open SpecWithCode. In setup, keep this computer and click Continue.
The Claude card should say Ready to code.
If it doesn't, run `claude auth login` in a terminal first.
Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path.
Pick Claude in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.
Type a dollar sign, pick `sw-increment`, and describe the change.
Claude writes `spec.md`: acceptance criteria and a task with its files and test.
Claude claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test.
The task is marked done only when the test passes.
Click Open diff to review the code, the test,
and the ledger line that records who finished the task.
Next, `sw-done` verifies and closes the increment.
